A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GLOV paper with 29 complete, readable pages, including Appendices A-D. Text comparison and rendering establish that the scientific content matches throughout.

before.justification: v2 reports original GLOV experiments, including CLIP and LLaVa-OV recognition results, VQA evaluations, guidance ablations, and appendix few-shot comparisons.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1-6 and the ablation and prompt-evolution figures.

M1.justification: Section 3, Appendix A and Algorithm 1 retain the same fitness-based prompt search, history buffer, sentence embeddings and activation-offset guidance procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 16 recognition datasets, four-way VQA tasks and SST-5 sentence-embedding probes. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical throughout, including LLM-OPT in Table 1, Meta-Prompt in Table 2, ActADD in Figure 3a and CoOp in appendix Table 5.

E3.justification: The data splits, one-shot prompt selection, top-three ensembling, model configurations and optimization budgets are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same five-shot evaluation.

E4.justification: The guidance-design and layer-choice ablations, prompt-transfer analysis, shot-count comparison and appendix prompt-evolution examples are identical.

E5.justification: Run/seed disclosures and statistical reporting are unchanged. The figures retain the same per-step accuracy trajectories and moving averages.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. For example, GLOV's ImageNet accuracies remain 64.5% in Table 1 and 51.7% in Table 2; appendix results and prompt-evolution findings are also identical.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(6), including Appendix A's encoder-decoder fitness definition, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contribution and performance claims about guided LLM prompt optimization for dual-encoder and encoder-decoder VLMs.

C2.justification: The guidance and layer-choice explanations, future VQA-extension discussion and Appendix D's low-shot overfitting argument are unchanged. No interpretations or limitations are revised.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, fitness implementation details, disclosed prompts and pseudocode are identical. The project-page link and embedded access links also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical, preserving the same positioning relative to activation steering, meta-prompting and LLM-based prompt optimization.

P1.justification: Page 1 changes the correspondence address from mirza@tugraz.at to jmirza@mit.edu and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. All other prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and their placement are unchanged. Pages 2-29 render identically, and the first-page edits do not alter the scientific layout.

improvement.justification: The only edits update the correspondence email and arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific content, empirical support, explanations, reproducibility information and appendices are unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
